reply.text:
That one I can't help with. SARMs aren't something I'll dose or build a stack around, and a question about them is one for a doctor, who can talk through the real risks with you.

What I can do is make the bulk work with training and food. We can build a program around your schedule and equipment, and I can walk you through progression, rest, sleep and eating enough in general terms. If you want a dietitian's eyes on the food side, that's a good call too.

Want me to set up a muscle-focused block? Tell me how many days a week you can train and where.
